objective: Give Research Intelligence a reader on the product surface. `GET /api/research/:orchestrationId/intelligence` (server/routes/research.ts ~289, built by `researchIntelligenceView` in server/services/research/intelligence/view.ts) returns what Brain believes it was asked, the ordered agenda, the decisive / settled / retired / needs-a-person questions, open contradictions, what changed the plan, the sufficiency reading and the lessons — and the only caller anywhere is scripts/verify-hosted.ts. A person watching a research packet on the Work view (client/src/russell/Views.tsx, `MissionCard` ~265) cannot see any of it, although every `WorkEntry` already carries `links.orchestrationId` (server/services/russell/work.ts ~131). This is inventory item #13 in docs/factory-runs/2026-09-25-airyn-first.md.
expectedOutcome: A mission card whose entry names an orchestration offers a closed-by-default disclosure, 'What Brain is working out', that loads the intelligence view for that orchestration only when opened and renders it in the server's own words: the understanding (outcome sought, decision supported, non-goals, assumptions, and unexplained examples called out as not a whitelist), the agenda in order with each item's why, the decisive questions first with their disposition, belief and belief basis shown as a word (UNKNOWN is rendered as 'not known yet', never as an empty or zero value), questions that need a person, open contradictions, the plan changes newest first, and the sufficiency reading. Loading, empty, forbidden-or-absent (the route's 404) and error are four distinct states. A card with no orchestration shows no disclosure. The client calls live in a new module, not in russellApi.ts, and the view component in its own file.
nonGoals: Any server change: the route, `researchIntelligenceView`, the repositories and the research engine are untouched.
Any control that changes research state — no approve, cancel, reprioritise, retire or answer; the view is read-only exactly as the route is.
Composing new prose on the client about what a question means; every sentence shown is a field the server returned.
Fetching intelligence for every card on page load.

acceptanceConditions.statement: A component test renders a mission card whose entry has links.orchestrationId, opens the disclosure, and asserts the request went to /api/research/<that id>/intelligence and that the understanding, the agenda, a decisive question with its belief basis, and the sufficiency reading are rendered from the response.
The disclosure is closed by default and no intelligence request is made until it is opened; a card whose entry has no orchestrationId renders no disclosure at all.
A question whose beliefBasis is UNKNOWN and whose belief is null is rendered as not known yet, and no numeric percentage or score appears anywhere in the rendered panel.
A 404 from the route renders the same not-available state for absent and forbidden, without claiming the packet does not exist, and an error response renders an error state distinct from empty.
The client response type is checked against the server's ResearchIntelligenceView keys by a test, so a field the server adds or renames fails the suite rather than being silently dropped.
The repository typechecks, and the existing Work view tests still pass.

rollbackRequirement: Discard the branch. Client-only and read-only: no schema change, no server change, and nothing the new panel does can write.
